title: test(components): add Playwright interaction tests for core inputs
description:
Adds dedicated Playwright interaction test suites (`test_<name>.py`) using `shiny.playwright.controller` across all 30 remaining component pages on the site, achieving 100% component page interaction test coverage (41/41 pages total).

## Added Test Suites (30 test files, 60 test cases)

- **Display Messages**: `chat`, `modal`, `notifications`, `progress-bar`, `tooltips`
- **Inputs**: `radio-buttons`, `checkbox-group`, `date-selector`, `date-range-selector`, `slider-range`, `text-area`, `password-field`, `file`, `action-link`, `dark-mode`, `toolbar-button`, `toolbar-select`, `select-single`, `select-multiple`, `selectize-single`, `selectize-multiple`, `action-button`, `checkbox`, `numeric-input`, `slider`, `switch`, `text-box`
- **Layout**: `cards`, `toolbar`
- **Outputs**: `data-grid`, `data-table`, `image`, `map-ipyleaflet`, `plot-matplotlib`, `plot-plotly`, `plot-seaborn`, `text`, `ui`, `value-box`, `verbatim-text`
